data.long_meaning: The name Sharvikaariyan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' meaning Goddess and 'Kaariyan' meaning the goddess of strength and courage. This name signifies the presence of a strong and courageous woman who embodies the divine feminine energy. The name Sharvikaariyan carries the meaning “Goddess of Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvikaariyan usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Sharvikaariyan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvikaariyan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Sharvikaariyan were a group of Hindu merchants and traders who flourished during the late medieval period in the Deccan region of India. They were particularly active in the trade of textiles, horses, and precious stones.

The Sharvikaariyan were also known for their religious patronage, particularly towards the god Shiva. They built several temples and funded the maintenance of existing ones. One of their most famous temples is the Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Varanasi, which is a major pilgrimage site for Hindus today.
